Before you apply

Loan Tips & Guides

Three things our experts check first, so you get approved faster and at a better rate.

Credit score

Aim for 750 or Higher

A CIBIL score above 750 usually unlocks the lowest rates. Pay card bills in full and keep card usage under 30% of the limit.

Ask an expert
Documents

Keep These Ready

PAN, Aadhaar, last 3 months' salary slips or 2 years' ITR, and 6 months' bank statements. Most approvals wait on paperwork.

Get the checklist
EMI planning

Keep EMIs Under 40%

Lenders prefer total EMIs below 40–50% of your monthly income. A longer tenure lowers the EMI but raises total interest.
